title: 7 Best Draftbit Alternatives in 2026: Honest Comparison
summary: Draftbit alternatives ranked for builders who want AI-built mobile apps with a backend that is not in beta, AI included in the price, and subscriptions set up for them. Blink, FlutterFlow, Adalo, Rork, Thunkable, Replit, Base44.
body_markdown: Yes, the Free plan has no time limit, a one-time grant of 5,000 credits, and web publishing on a draftbit.dev address. Code export and store publishing start on Standard at $15/mo, or $12/mo billed yearly.
